summary: Build practical Stata skills for time series, GARCH, panel data, and asset-pricing analysis. Enroll in a 5-day course.
lede: Financial econometrics uses Stata to analyze financial data and support forecasting, valuation, and risk decisions. The course is for financial and risk analysts, investment analysts, and economists who prepare data, test stationarity, and estimate ARIMA and GARCH models. Participants also practice asset-pricing regressions, panel-data and event-study methods, model diagnostics, and clear reporting of findings and limitations.
audienceIntro: This course is built for professionals who analyze financial data, model market behavior, and present evidence for technical or executive decisions.
outcomes: Time Series Data Management In Stata
prerequisites: To get the most value from this course, you should already have working knowledge of statistics, regression analysis, and basic financial concepts such as returns, volatility, and risk. Prior exposure to econometrics is helpful, and no programming background is required beyond comfort using data software menus and commands. A laptop with Stata installed is recommended for hands-on exercises, and familiarity with Excel or CSV data files will help you move faster during the labs.
